title: Historic 1865 Loft | Sleeps 8 | Pool|Mins to Gulch
description:
Stay inside Nashville history — literally. This brick-and-beam loft lives in an 1865 factory building, now Marathon Village: craft coffee, whiskey tastings & live music steps from your door. Sleeps 8 across 2 bedrooms + sofa beds, with a sunny pool for hot days. 5 min to The Gulch, 7 to Broadway — close to everything, quieter than downtown. Original brick, huge windows, 160 years of character & free parking. The loft your group remembers.

The space
Indulge your inner chef in the sleek kitchen, equipped with a full suite of stainless steel appliances. 2 bedrooms one with extra large closet and queen size bed. The other bedroom has bunk beds with large closet. The second bedroom also has a vanity with sink and mirror. This is perfect for multiple people getting ready at the same time. Extra perks include central AC and a private washer/dryer.

- Early Check-in is available starting from 2:00 PM instead of 4:00 PM.
- Late Check-out is available ending at 12:00 PM instead of 10:00 AM.

Guest access
FREE Parking. 

You will have access to the entire condo to yourself, and all the shared spaces the community provides.

The amenities included at "The 1865"

Outdoor dipping pool and poolside loungers 
Outdoor kitchen with two gas grills, four large TVs, and a firepit
Top-floor observation deck with skyline-view lounge
Fitness room
Gated and controlled access

Other things to note
**Train tracks are located behind the property and passing trains may occasionally be heard.

**This complex is majority Short Term Rentals so there is a chance you may hear other guest in the building.

**Note regarding the pool: It is up to our HOA to determine the exact date of when the pool opens & closes throughout the year. It is heated but only enough not to freeze during the Winter.

We are located in the heart of Downtown Nashville, where the vibrant city life adds to the charm of your stay. However, you may occasionally hear sounds from cars, planes, trains, party buses, dogs, other guests in the building, or lively passersby enjoying the area. While we can't control these elements, we hope you’ll embrace the energy of Music City as part of your experience!

Smoking Fee - $250
